notices.info: Prizes may be distributed in-person or shipped post-hackathon. Each member of each winning team will get the prize. Prizes will be distributed during closing ceremony.
notices.warning: A team may not win more than one prize total from the Grand Prizes and Track Prizes. They may win multiple prizes from Challenge Prizes, even in addition to a grand or track prize.
